name: EPDF
welcome: Welcome to **EPDF**, the PDF viewer for the Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon. Its text view shows the text of every page of a document, one after another, on any machine down to a 1 MB ST: the paragraphs joined and wrapped to the window, or each line as it is on the page.

window.title: The window
items: A page's head: every page follows the one before.
The text: scroll it with the arrows, Space and the slider; ^Left and ^Right turn the pages.
The status bar: the page at the top, and what EPDF is doing, with a line that fills as it goes.
